sources.name: A-3 Justifier Mk.V
sources.description: The Mk.V from A-3 is a work of wonder. A-3 took the improved version of the Mk.II that the Desert Rangers had designed, and made a new standard weapon based on their findings. Speed over power was the goal, and this means that the Mk.V is a rapid-firing assault carbine, capable of mid-range offensive and defensive roles. This weapon is not imported to Calypso, but a few sources say that it can be found nevertheless.

sources.name: A-3 Punisher Mk.II
sources.description: Affirmative Action Arms has recognized the need for more powerful civilian weapons and designed this modified version of their A-3 Punisher. It was distributed amongst selected civilians for extended field-testing but the results have still not been made official. Rumors has it that the expectations where set a little too high. Even so it’s said that this weapon is one step closer to match the more advanced military Justifier carbines, making the Punisher Mk.II a little more than just another functional weapon.

sources.name: Adjusted A&P Series Hero
sources.description: Many people have been drawn to the Series Heroes simple design and rugged mechanics. This has also attributed to several attempts to enhance this fine carbine further. The Calypso-born Yssete Riemeriu is one of those who did manage to get a company running on her adjustments. The weapon has seen several interesting innovations, including a better ventilation system, a faster generator and an inner casing of durable super-alloys.

sources.name: Adjusted A-3 Justifier  Mk.V
sources.description: The Mk.V is a rare  sighting on Calypso, as it almost always is smuggled to the colony. The mad hacker/tech-wiz Wulfer "Krankheit" Blau  adjusted a version of the weapon, using standard replacement parts out of the book. The design was spread and many applied  the ideas to the Mk.V`s available on the planet. The basic things exchanged were the trigger servo, the mirror  amplification emitter in the barrel and some excess weighty parts in the stock. After Blau vanished during an expedition in  the mountains south of Hadesheim, the designs were nowhere to be found - all public copies self-disintegrated.

sources.name: Adjusted Omegaton ASG-3 Warthog
sources.description: Imperial Interface Major Rambaldi "Warthog" Inverness asked famed tinkerer Roman Ram to make modifications to the original Warthog design, to suit his need to higher reliability, effect, and destructive power. The adjusted model was so successful, and Major Inverness asked for large scale manufacturing for his entire one hundred men strong unit, "The screaming angels". Most of the weapons are still in unit possession, but a few have been dispersed following the death of individual squad members.

sources.name: Adjusted Sollomate Outbacko
sources.description: Even though the original Outbacko was designed for youngsters, it was still a little on the heavy side. Therefore a private company, known as Welles & Adams Co., made a version that was easier to use. The weight of this adjusted weapon has been reduced through the use of lighter materials in several key parts of the weapon. On the negative side, these new materials are not very good at limiting the heat build-up, thus making the rate of fire somewhat lesser compared with the original series.

sources.name: Improved A-3 Justifier Mk.II
sources.description: Some of the famous Desert Rangers still disagreed about their standard issue weapon and decided to make their own improvement of the Mk.II model. The converter was exchanged again, together with the whole cooling system. The changes make the weapon an even more efficient defensive weapon, as the Desert Rangers call it. Only a few of these weapons have found their way outside the Rangers ranks, and some of the more proud members of the Desert Ranger core consider it an offense if a non-Ranger carries this exceptional weapon.

Several improved Mk.II`s were analyzed and the same  perseverance during the development process was applied to this weapon. sources.name: Modified Tegretov TR6
sources.description: The Zychion Duke and Imperial Commander Rahls Unbaraz wanted a series of  rifles to indicate his personal guards. The native designer Kox Katre, decorated war hero and appointed Licenced Imperal  Weapon Smith, took the task. He based the design on the combat-proven TR6, but made the weapon more robust with a core  bolt-carrier of valurite. The barrel was exchanged for a heavy precision counterpart and the internal cooling system was  enhanced threefold, allowing for a higher rate of fire. Finally, the weapon was applied with a special coat of  anti-corrosive paint in the Duke of Zychion`s colors of red, blue and black.

sources.name: Omegaton ASG-3 Warthog
sources.description: The Omegaton ASG-series consists of auto-loading shotguns used for massive damage at close range. They are very useful for cleansing bunkers, assaulting strongholds and laying waste to foes quickly. They use ordinary BLP packs, but launch several bullets per pull of the trigger, to create the classical shotgun pellet effect. The large bore of the weapon makes the range limited though. The Warthog was such a success in military circles that a special version of the shotgun was created, by the legendary Roman Ram.

sources.name: Thorifoid Battle Club
sources.description: The Thorifoids are one of the more aggressive classes of mutants. Imperial Scout/Recon teams have observed them in an attempt to gather data. The mutants possess knowledge in Mindforce, together with their rage in combat makes them a formidable threat against colonists trying to survive. They appear to like close combat, as it makes excellent use of their high body strength. They seem to be able to make weapons in crude factories. Therefore the various bashing weapons they use are very suitable for this.

sources.name: Improved DOA Strikehammer
sources.description: The leader of the elite Imperial Interphase Commandos,  Lt.Cmmdr Raxxor Caaine, made a special request to the legendary armsmaker Roman Ram about a series of specialized  Strikehammers. The IICom was mainly used to attack robot bulk ships in other space, and they found the Strikehammer to be a  very nice weapon to mow down the hordes of robots on these carriers. The original team of just 30 troopers all survived  over 22 missions before the team was retired and sent back to Earth. Some of the weapons did however end up in the  backwater places of Calypso.

sources.name: Improved EWE EP-21 Defender
sources.description: Dr Macc MacMahon is the genius behind this limited release weapon. Its numbers can be counted in the lower thousands, but it is still very much in demand from serious enthusiasts. The design changes mostly affected the components, which were almost completely replaced by custom-built parts imported from Earth. Its quality has been praised in every review this fine weapon has ever appeared in. Unfortunately, EWE did not like Dr MacMahons ideas and pulled the plug on further development, leaving the world with just the weapons manufactured up to that date.

sources.name: Improved Omegaton M2870
sources.description: This weapon alteration had one single purpose, and that was to reduce the amount of energy used on each attack. A lot of testing was required before Peul Forosixi Design found the right components. Rumor has it that it is based on old robot technology, something violently denied by Peul Forosixi personally. Nevertheless, the design was a great success, although the weapon is very hard to find since the secret part always seems to be out of stock.

sources.name: Modified EWE EP-40 Mercenary
sources.description: The modified version of the ordinary EP-40 is based on an old design by Dr Macc MacMahon. The weapon uses an old but reliable trigger cooling design invented by Dr MacMahon himself but which was never accepted by any large weapons manufacturer. Although good in theory, the trigger design is not fine-tuned, and requires constant maintenance to function properly. The inventor did not like the final result and this weapon is scarce.

sources.name: Improved Fire Forge ARR 8000
sources.description: The improved ARR 8000 is a collaboration between Dr Macc MacMahon and the prestigious firm Welles & Adams Co. The objectives of the improvement, to give the shooter longer effective range, together with a smoother firing cycle have been met. The new cycle system is a completely new design, made by Dr MacMahon, and some people praise it as one of his best inventions yet. The precision barrel made in a Zero-G environment with state-of-the-art drilling techniques is also a masterpiece of engineering perfection. The result is a powerful rifle, capable of setting the robot menace aflame even faster than before.

sources.description: The Kaiser-Graf series of gauss rifles (or, "Railguns") is a rare occurrence on Calypso. This bulky high-velocity magnetic rifle is state of the art and is a new weapon of choice against robots. Their rate of fire is quite high, but the range is somewhat limited due to the low mass the projectile fired. As all first generation new technology their real effectiveness on the battlefield remains to be seen.The HVMR-1 series is a basic model for modern battlefield usage, and aimed to the grunts who are fighting the robot menace.

sources.description: This weapon was originally assigned to a special taskforce that was involved in covert search and rescue missions during the mop-up operations after the first robot war. The intense heat from the plasma emission gives the weapon a slow recharge.

sources.name: Marber Tango-Type Plasma Annihilator
sources.description: The Plasma sniper was issued in small numbers to the crack insertion force known as the Crimson Devils. They were a rowdy bunch of ex-convicts given another chance in the Imperal Forces. They often worked in small teams on Amethera, striking against robots and other threats to the colonists during the war. Their methods were to strike with stealth – fast, hard and to disappear before the enemy got any bearing on their position. Most of the group was killed in a nuclear explosion at the Northern parts of Amethera, when a robot strike shuttle crashed onto their main campsite.

sources.name: Meckel & Loch PSG-45 Sniper
sources.description: Meckel & Loch made a sniper version of their  versatile ML-series of battle rifles. The entire bolt section, BLP-mixing chambers and caliber was upgraded to allow for a  rapid mechanism allowing for tight accurate burst groups. The barrel was exchanged to a heavy version made out of precision  high grade xeremite/durulium alloys, drilled in zero-G. The result is an impressive Imperial Force/Recon Sniper rifle  capable of taking out a mutant with one shot - if the sharpshooter is good enough. The weapon`s fine precision mechanics do  however require a lot of maintenance to operate at peak performance.

sources.name: Modified Fire Forge BGH 4400M
sources.description: After a debate, the constructor Remrick Era’Nolann felt that a fast, reliable hunting rifle was something the hunting public wanted. After a meeting with Fire Forge, Era’Nolann made a deal to produce a test run of a couple of hundred weapons, to be used on Calypso. The design, a light fast firing hunting rifle, did attract a few customers, but Fire Forge were not pleased, and therefore stopped production after the test run was completed. This also made sure that production quality was never improved, and unfortunately several weapons in the series are flawed in certain ways. Era’Nolann himself was very distraught by this, but began his search for a new weapon to modify.

sources.name: Modified Fire Forge DAR 9300
sources.description: This weapon is an awesome killing instrument. Designed with the sole purpose of inflicting the maximum amount of damage possible, at any cost. Its engineer is the genius Yssete Riemeriu, who enjoyed success with her previous designs. Riemeriu pulled off a magnificent feat with this weapon, managing to nearly double the energy output. The toll on the weapon itself is high though, as well as the energy consumed. Also the massive energy conversion makes the weapon slow in cooling sufficiently to allow for a high rate of fire. Only a few units were ever produced, as Riemeriu moved on to different projects.

sources.name: Modified Omegaton M71 A2
sources.description: The engineer Roman Ram is behind this creation, only developed in a few hundred units. The energy conversion fields are reprogrammed to accelerate the energy quicker, thus inflicting more damage on the enemy, but at a lesser range. Some of the newer materials used are also lighter. Some intense combat personalities have this weapon as a mark of their professionalism. A few isolated, an unconfirmed, cases have been reported in the media that the quality of this modified weapon is questionable, and this was the reason for Ram discontinuing its development and production.

sources.description: The Omegaton ASG-series consists of auto-loading shotguns used for massive damage at close range. They are very useful for cleansing bunkers, assaulting strongholds and laying waste to foes quickly. They use ordinary BLP packs, but launch several bullets per pull of the trigger, to create the classical shotgun pellet effect. The large bore of the weapon makes the range limited though.

sources.description: The Omegaton M61 A5 is the old standard combat rifle on Calypso. It is a reliable friend in combat, but even if this is its sixth reincarnation since its birth, the newer combat rifles are more competent in doing what the M61 A5 has always done. One thing the M61A5 suffers from is it requires quite a lot of maintenance to work at peak performance.

sources.name: Dagger of Despair
sources.description: The Red "D"-series of daggers is a rare occurrence on Calypso. Nobody seems to know where they originate from, and their design suggest other than human development. The name of the dagger is seen in the blade from time to time and some even claim they blade speak to them in certain circumstances. Some scientists believe the daggers are of alien origin, and that they indicate that a people other than humans inhabited Calypso sometime in the past. The Federal Empire rigorously counters any such statement as "utter nonsense" though.

sources.name: Improved Castorian Survival EnBlade-7
sources.description: The famed hunter/explorer ‘Brave’ Bruce Bryce designed this model on the standard Survival EnBlade-7, one of his favorite weapons. The design utilizes a high-performance generator and energy matrix, together with an ever-sharp dual mono-edge. The weapon is in limited supply, as it was never made in any large numbers. This blade is a good companion in the unexplored world of Calypso, and the feeling that the weapon is ‘approved’ by Bruce Bryce himself heightens the experience.

sources.name: Unique Legend War Axe
sources.description: Within the old Order of the Empire, two brothers proved themselves as prominent and devout followers of the faith. The brothers, Jacob and Ivian Kallous, of Mars heritage, always worked together and soon became the most well-known keepers of the secrets within the order. The Chapter Overlord was concerned when the reports of the robot assault on humanity on Calypso reached him, and set forth sending an elite cadre to destroy the abomination rising against its creator. Leading the cadre unit were the brothers. Just prior to departure they received a gift each - a finely crafted and meticulously prepared weapon, made by the wisest engineers within the Order Keep.Ivian, the larger of the two brothers, received the Legend War Axe, a mighty weapon that cleaved enemies like rye to the scythe. The axe seemed to glow with a life-like pulse when Ivian used in the combat to strike down the foes of mankind. Ivian and his team managed to kill some two thousand robots during the war, and it wasn't until late in the campaign that the robots seemed to acknowledge the power Ivian had in him, so they decided to trick him. The clever trap sprung as the team lead by the stalwart leader entered a bombed out outpost near Zychion Citadel. Once in the ruins, the robots attacked with a massive force, but when the machines concluded they would lose this battle to the giant of a man, they initiated the destruction of the power plant under the ruins - effectively disintegrating every living being several kilometers away. A Federal Search and Rescue party found the Legend War Axe in the ruins, apparently untouched by the massive destructive force from the blast. What happened to the axe after that is not established as no further records can be found.
